correctness.rationale: A complete conditional-expectation calculation yields the mixed-moment recurrence with the marked leaf indicator. Telescoping gives the exact covariance, and the finite difference controls its shape. Two fully expanded positive-coefficient rational-polynomial certificates prove the strict signs at both adjacent transition positions for all birth labels using Wallis asymptotics. Independent symbolic/rational checking reproduced all identities and 512 exact dynamic-programming assertions; no finite test is used as an infinite proof.

originality.rationale: Full primary inspection of the 1993 plane-oriented recursive-tree article, the 2017 fixed-label degree article and the 2021 plane increasing leaf-rank article found marginal, branch, and random-rank laws, but not the claimed fixed nonroot birth-label versus global leaf covariance or sharp \(9j-3\) threshold. residual_risks: A less obvious older mixed-moment identity could implicitly yield the same result; literature search and inspected full texts cannot certify exhaustive historic priority.

value.rationale: A natural, global-versus-local dependence in a canonical uniform plane increasing tree changes sign for every marked nonroot label at exactly \(n=9j-3\). The label-dependent sharp integer threshold and scaling function (critical ratio 9) expose a structural phenomenon unavailable from the separate known degree and leaf marginal laws; this is a complete natural classification with a nontrivial rational certificate.
